Our core preschool program provides a rich, play-based curriculum that prepares children for kindergarten and beyond. Children engage in hands-on learning across literacy, math, science, and the arts.

Curriculum Highlights

  • Emergent literacy and phonics readiness
  • Math concepts through manipulatives and games
  • Science experiments and nature journals
  • Creative arts, music, and dramatic play

School Readiness Skills

  • Letter recognition and early reading
  • Number sense and basic math operations
  • Writing name and simple sentences
  • Collaborative projects and presentations
